title: Duck Hunt
desc: Aim the crosshair and shoot rising ducks before they escape; clear three rounds of limited shots to win.

title: Curve Fever
desc: Steer a growing line through the arena and outlast the computer or a friend; first to five round wins takes the match.

title: Sokoban
desc: Push every crate onto its target across five warehouse levels, with undo, move counters and a stuck-crate lose state.

title: Nonogram
desc: Reveal hidden pictures by filling cells from the number clues, with 5x5 and 10x10 grids and a mistakes counter.

title: Tower of Hanoi
desc: Move the whole stack between pegs under the classic rules, spending a minimal 2^n - 1 move budget to win.
